desc:
⚠️IMPORTANT! THIS GAME IS STILL IN HEAVY DEVELOPMENT, MORE CONTENT SOON⚠️

Dive into the world of Hunters where you are chosen by the system, as the main character you must prepare to fight dangerous enemies & powerful bosses.

🗡️ Fight hordes of enemies & conquer dungeons to level up!
🔄 Click "ROLL" to roll various types of loot that will help you progress!
👫 Team up with friends to defeat powerful bosses!

Level up offline — return later to harvest your exp gains!

📢 Join our community for live updates and announcements!
🍀 Join our group for extra luck boosts!
https://www.roblox.com/communities/35687503/MS-Hunters#!/about

Do you have what it takes to become the king of humans? 👑 

🎮CONTROLS:
M1 - Basic Attack
M2 - Feint
W+W - RUN
F - Block (Time for Parry)
Q - DASH
